official.deadline_note: Applications run 30/10/2026-13/11/2026 and the module closes at 23:59:59 Peru time per the cronograma in the bases (numeral 9.3); no separate institutional deadline applies. Review/subsanacion 03/11-24/11/2026, results 15/12/2026, acceptance 16/12-21/12/2026.
official.application_cycle: Convocatoria extraordinaria 2026 - Beca Generacion del Bicentenario (RDE n. 149-2026)
official.status_note: The official page presents the extraordinary 2026 call ('El Peru cuenta con tu talento') as the current round, with the published cronograma of the bases: application 30/10/2026-13/11/2026, subsanation 03/11-24/11/2026, selection results published 15/12/2026, acceptance 16/12-21/12/2026 and the final scholarship-holder list from 22/12/2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Matricula y pension de estudios se financian de conformidad con las 'Normas para la Ejecucion de Subvenciones para Estudios en el Extranjero'; incluye todos los conceptos obligatorios y necesarios exigidos por la IES ('mandatory services', 'student fees', 'student services'). No se financia la doble titulacion.
official.funding_period: total contest budget for up to 20 scholarships
benefits: Matricula (tuition/enrolment) y pension de estudios, per the Normas para la Ejecucion de Subvenciones para Estudios en el Extranjero
Obtencion del grado y/o titulo respectivo y trabajo de investigacion para la obtencion del grado (thesis costs)
Transporte internacional (Peru to destination city and back, only at the start and end of the programme)
Alojamiento y alimentacion, including 15 days before classes start and 15 days after studies end
Movilidad local y seguro medico (health, life, accidents and repatriation coverage)
Costos administrativos, per the Normas para la Ejecucion de Subvenciones para Estudios en el Extranjero
eligibility: Tener nacionalidad peruana conforme al ordenamiento juridico vigente (DNI verified online with RENIEC)

Acreditar estudios de pregrado o posgrado concluidos: grado de Bachiller, titulo profesional o titulo profesional tecnico para maestria; grado o diploma de maestria para doctorado (foreign degrees must be recognised by SUNEDU)
Acreditar alto rendimiento academico: pertenecer al tercio superior o percentil equivalente como minimo (primer/segundo puesto, decimo o quinto superior score higher)
Tener insuficientes recursos economicos: ingreso bruto promedio mensual per capita familiar igual o menor a 7 RMV, equivalente a S/ 7,910
Acreditar experiencia profesional minima de dos (2) anos, contados desde la obtencion del grado de Bachiller o titulo hasta el inicio de la fase de postulacion

Contar con la carta de aceptacion definitiva de una IES elegible (rankeada entre las primeras 400 en QS, ARWU o THE al menos una vez en los ultimos 5 anos) para estudios que inician entre el 01/07/2026 y el 31/12/2027; no hay limite de edad para postular
requirements: Carta de aceptacion definitiva e incondicional de la IES elegible with: IES and programme names, applicant's full name, no payment/visa/funding conditions, signature of an institutional representative, start and end month-year (including thesis), curriculum, full-time in-person modality, and the total programme cost
Documento oficial de la IES de procedencia que acredite el alto rendimiento academico with the accumulated weighted average and the percentile obtained at graduation

Acreditar un buen perfil profesional y/o de investigacion (master's: one academic period of teaching/teaching support, or a completed specialisation/diploma of at least 120 academic hours; doctorate: an indexed-journal article, a book, or active RENACYT registration)
Certificados de trabajo, constancias de prestacion de servicios o CUL que acrediten dos anos de experiencia profesional (volunteering and ad-honorem work do not count)

Ficha Socioeconomica completed in the application module plus 2025 income documents for the household (SUNAT annual income declarations, fifth-category withholding certificates, sworn declaration per Anexo 03)

Certificado de salud fisica (medico colegiado) y certificado de salud mental (psiquiatra colegiado), each with maximum validity of 120 days; no negative rating (deficient, doubtful or loss) in the SBS credit-risk registry
documents: DNI (consulted online with RENIEC) and degree/title (verified automatically in SUNEDU's national registry of grades and titles)
Official certificate of high academic performance stating the accumulated weighted average and percentile
Definitive acceptance letter from the eligible IES, plus a Constancia de matricula if studies start before 30/10/2026
Professional/research profile evidence and work experience certificates covering at least two years
Ficha Socioeconomica and 2025 income documentation for household members (SUNAT certificates or sworn declaration)

Physical and mental health certificates (validity up to 120 days) and the sworn declarations/formats generated by the application module (Ficha de Postulacion, veracity declaration, no-impediment declaration)
selection_criteria: Puntaje de Seleccion = A (perfil profesional y academico) + B (IES de destino) + C (condiciones priorizables); max 130 points for master's and 150 for doctorate
Selection prioritises applicants whose pregrado/professional career or master's programme appears in the EDO 2026 Top-10 high-demand lists of the MTPE, in strict order of merit

Tie-breakers in order: public-sector employment commitment letter or study licence, private-sector letter, higher merit order, lower individual gross income, higher-ranked destination IES, holding another academic scholarship, priorizable condition, and residence in the poorest district (2018 poverty map)
coverage: Matricula y pension de estudios (all mandatory IES fees such as 'mandatory services' and 'student fees')
Obtencion del grado y/o titulo respectivo (degree/titration costs) and the research work for the thesis
Transporte internacional at the start and end of the programme (direct or with layovers, economy fares)
Alojamiento y alimentacion, subsidised from 15 days before classes until 15 days after completion, conditional on presence in the destination country
Movilidad local and seguro medico with health, life, accident and repatriation cover
Costos administrativos per the Normas para la Ejecucion de Subvenciones para Estudios en el Extranjero
application_method: Apply virtually through the Modulo de Postulacion of the SIBEC on PRONABEC's institutional portal (www.gob.pe/pronabec), 'Postula aqui', between 30/10/2026 and 13/11/2026
Scan and upload every mandatory document (both sides where applicable) as legible A4 PDF files of maximum 2 MB each
Correct observations during the Fase de Revision y Subsanacion (03/11-24/11/2026); missing mandatory documents or illegible/enamelled uploads are declared NO APTO without subsanation
Selected applicants accept the scholarship electronically by signing the acceptance format and the Compromiso de Servicio al Peru between 16/12/2026 and 21/12/2026
official.application_route: Online application via the SIBEC application module on PRONABEC's portal (www.gob.pe/pronabec) within the 30/10/2026-13/11/2026 window
official.study_mode: Full-time, in-person (presencial) in the destination country; semi-presential, fully asynchronous or virtual programmes are excluded
official.citizenship_residency: Peruvian nationality is mandatory and the DNI is verified online with RENIEC; the call is national in scope
official.international_eligibility: Only Peruvian nationals may apply; the funded programme of study must be taken abroad
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The destination IES must be PRONABEC-eligible (top 400 in QS, ARWU or THE at least once in the last five years, per the eligible-IES list RJ n. 2953-2026); published lists prioritise EDO 2026 high-demand careers for master's applicants and high-demand master's programmes for doctoral applicants
official.research_requirement: Doctoral applicants must evidence research output: at least one article in an indexed journal or a book in the last five years, or active registration in RENACYT; the thesis research work for the degree is a funded benefit
official.duration: The duration of the programme stated in the acceptance letter, including thesis elaboration; the funded studies must start between 01/07/2026 and 31/12/2027
official.description: PRONABEC's extraordinary 2026 call 'El Peru cuenta con tu talento' offers 20 integral scholarships (17 master's, 3 doctoral) so Peruvian professionals with high academic performance and insufficient economic resources can study a postgraduate programme abroad at an eligible top-400 ranked university and turn their knowledge into development opportunities for Peru; there is no age limit to apply.
official.program_type: Government scholarship - Beca Posgrado (PRONABEC, Ministerio de Educacion del Peru)

not_confirmed: Per-scholar funding value (individual tuition, monthly living or travel amounts) - PRONABEC sets these per concept through OAF cost-determination resolutions, and no figure is published in the bases, the official page or the subvention norms

english_requirement - neither the bases nor the official page publish an English test (IELTS/TOEFL) or medium-of-instruction requirement; the only language rule is that documents in a language other than Spanish need a simple signed translation
verification.notes: Amount, cronograma, requisites, documents, scoring and benefits were verified against PRONABEC's official Beca Generacion Bicentenario page and the contest bases RDE n. 149-2026; the only published figure is the total contest budget of S/ 4,650,946.00 charged to fiscal year 2027 for up to 20 new scholarships.

applicant_utility.summary: This is PRONABEC's flagship integral postgraduate scholarship for study abroad: 20 awards (17 master's, 3 doctoral) covering tuition, living costs, international travel and insurance at a top-400 ranked university, with benefits running from 1 January 2027. The whole cycle is compressed into seven weeks - apply by 13 November 2026, results land on 15 December and acceptance must be completed within six days. Admission comes before funding: you need a definitive, unconditional acceptance letter and a top-third academic ranking before you can even submit.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Peruvian professionals in the top third of their graduating class, with two years' work experience, household per-capita income at or below S/ 7,910 a month, and a firm unconditional offer from a top-400 ranked university for a 2026-27 start.
application_readiness_checklist: Request an unconditional acceptance letter that names the IES and programme, your full name, start and end month-year including thesis, the curriculum, full-time in-person modality and the total programme cost - anything with payment, visa or funding conditions is rejected as not definitive

Ask your university for a certificate stating your accumulated weighted average and your exact graduation percentile (tercio superior is the floor); if it shows per-term percentils only, the lowest is used

Collect 2025 SUNAT income evidence for every household member (fifth-category withholding certificates, annual income declarations, electronic receipts report) and confirm the per-capita monthly figure stays at or below S/ 7,910
Book your medical and psychiatric appointments now so both certificates are issued within 120 days of submission, and verify the doctors' registration at conoceatumedico.cmp.org.pe
Prepare your profile evidence early: teaching/support certificates signed by the administration (never by teachers), a 120-hour diploma, or your indexed article, book or RENACYT certificate
common_rejection_risks: Conditional acceptance letters (payment, visa or funding conditions) are not considered definitive acceptance and end the application
Acceptance letters missing mandatory data - no total cost, no start/end dates, no curriculum or no modality - make the file NO APTO
An academic-performance certificate without a global graduation percentile, or a percentile below tercio superior
Per-capita household income above S/ 7,910, a negative SBS credit-risk rating, or income data that contradicts SUNAT/ESSALUD/SBS cross-checks
Work experience proved only by volunteer or ad-honorem work, parallel jobs counted once, or certificates lacking the signatory's name, role and signature
Degrees from foreign universities not recognised by SUNEDU, and semi-presential, company-run, foundation or double-degree programmes, which are expressly excluded
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Installation and personal expenses, dependants' costs and language-levelling courses are expressly not funded, laptop and insurance purchases above the OAF-set caps are out of pocket, and since benefits only run from 1 January 2027 with no retroactive recognition, any study time or costs incurred before that date are entirely yours.
document_audit: Every mandatory document must be uploaded both sides, legible, as an A4 PDF of maximum 2 MB; incomplete or illegible uploads are declared NO APTO with no subsanation window

Documents in a language other than Spanish need a simple translation carrying the translator's full name and signature - official translations are not required, but unsigned or unidentified translations fail
Sworn declarations, annexes and formats generated by the SIBEC module keep their formalities; check whether an annex must be downloaded and carries a handwritten signature before upload
alerts: The acceptance window is only 16-21 December 2026 - a selected applicant who misses the electronic acceptance of the scholarship and the Compromiso de Servicio al Peru is declared a non-accepting applicant and loses the slot
Benefits start on 1 January 2027 and no benefits are recognised for study time already completed, so a programme that started in 2026 is only funded from January 2027 onward
Awardees must sign the Compromiso de Servicio al Peru: work in Peru for a period equal to the subsidised time, capped at three years

You cannot apply if you previously held a state-funded integral scholarship at the same level, renounced or lost a PRONABEC scholarship at that level, or falsified socio-economic, academic or health information

Selection prioritises EDO 2026 high-demand careers - check the prioritised and non-priorised study lists on the official page before choosing your programme, and remember only 20 awards exist (17 master's, 3 doctoral)
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register in the SIBEC application module on PRONABEC's portal, complete the socio-economic ficha, upload all mandatory A4 PDFs and submit before 13/11/2026 23:59 Peru time, then watch the review/subsanation window (03/11-24/11/2026), results (15/12/2026) and the six-day acceptance window (16-21/12/2026).
